findings.current: ...children's school vans must have both the approach warning and reversing warning sound systems.
findings.proposed: School vans must have both the rear-view image system (item 1) and the reversing warning sound system (item 3).
findings.evidence: Body: 'However, school vans for children shall be equipped with both the devices in items 1 and 3' (item 1 = rear-view image system, item 2 = approach warning, item 3 = reversing warning sound).

findings.proposed: none (no direct UN counterpart for accelerator control return-to-idle); remove R79
findings.evidence: UN R79 covers steering equipment; Article 87 body only concerns accelerator pedal return to idle within 1 s after releasing force / circuit fault.

UN R157 is Automated Lane Keeping Systems (L3). The Lane Departure Warning System regulation is UN R130 ('establishes uniform provisions for approval of motor vehicles equipped with a Lane Departure Warning System (LDWS)').

findings.proposed: UN R118 (closest, burning behaviour of interior materials; scope M3 only) or none
findings.evidence: UN R21 is interior fittings (impact), not flammability. Art 95 sets a 102 mm/min burn-rate limit. R118 'applies to the burning behaviour (ignitibility, burning rate...) of materials used in vehicles of categories M3 Classes II and III' (limit 100 mm/min).
